                    <span class="qodef-st-background-text" style="text-align: left"></span>
        					<h2 class="qodef-st-title" >
				URLA SURF HOUSE			</h2>
		                        <span class="qodef-st-caption" >Urla Surf House is a small beach hotel on the Gulbahce Kitesurf beach in Urla, Izmir, Turkey.</span>
        					<p class="qodef-st-text" >
				We have a view on the kitesurf spot, a kitesurf school on the beach, a skate ramp in the backyard, the only kiteboarding specific wakepark in Europe, and a few SUP boards for a cruise in the river or all the way to the island. We are the first kitesurf center here, and we are the only ones with a hotel directly on a kitesurf beach in Turkey!			</p>

		<div class="qodef-eh-item-content qodef-eh-custom-3991" style="padding: 75px 0 0 0">
			
	<div  class="wpb_single_image wpb_content_element vc_align_left wpb_content_element">
		
		<figure class="wpb_wrapper vc_figure">
